title: ATLAS model card — minimal conformance profile
description: The minimal tier is deliberately identical to the base ATLAS model schema: only Name and Link are required. This profile exists so that all three tiers are addressable at a stable, dated URL; it adds no constraints beyond schema-2026-12/model.json.
$comment: Conformance profile per atlas-chai-crosswalk.md Priority 4. Profiles are computed by the registry at ingest, not declared by the card author; cards continue to declare "$schema": ".../model.json".
